slice.leaf: Audit Sigstore Rekor as a public append-only independently hosted inclusion-witness candidate for scheduled Chat state/evidence.

sources.observed: Rekor is an immutable/tamper-resistant transparency log with a REST API; the public instance is rekor.sigstore.dev and supports auditing of append-only consistency.
Existing entries can be retrieved and inclusion proof verified; creating an entry uses rekor-cli upload with an artifact signature, public key and artifact.
A live unauthenticated GET returned signed tree-head/root-hash data for the public log during this slice.

candidate_comparison.signing_requirement: client must provide a valid signature/public key for standard Rekor upload flows
candidate_comparison.write_transport_requirement: entry creation requires an upload/POST-capable client; the regular public-web surface used here is read-only and the connected GitHub API cannot create Rekor entries
candidate_comparison.manual_or_protected_dependency: not_required_for_read_only_verification; unresolved_for_generic_creation because a usable signing identity/key plus external POST-capable path is required

slice.tested_scope: Official Sigstore Rekor overview/CLI documentation plus one live unauthenticated GET of the public Rekor log tree head. No external log mutation, signing-key creation, OIDC/Fulcio flow, rekor upload, generic HTTP POST, manual action, paid/finite quota, protected execution, scheduler mutation, wait/poll/backoff, or second semantic leaf was attempted.

frontier: Preserve the prior single-ref immutable transaction-record plus force=false ref-update design as the current Chat-callable repository baseline.
Software Heritage remains optional post-crawl independent corroboration, not a deterministic immediate witness.

Rekor can independently verify and timestamp data only once a valid entry exists; read-only verification is Chat-compatible, but current generic entry creation is not yet proven Chat-callable without an external POST/signing path.
exact_continuation: Fresh-bootstrap manifest/lifecycle/root/config and reconstruct r287 from LATEST. Execute exactly one bounded CLEAN child: audit OpenTimestamps public calendar submission/verification (or an equivalent standards-documented keyless transparency/timestamp service) as a candidate that might remove Rekor's signing-identity requirement. Determine whether witness creation can be performed by an operation actually exposed to scheduled Chat with zero optional monthly quota and zero incremental cost; distinguish read-only verification from irreversible external submission and fail closed if creation still depends on a non-Chat POST/socket path, manual action, protected execution or finite quota. Preserve Rekor as a strong read-only witness for preexisting entries, not as generic immediate Chat parity evidence.
